description: api.aws is an AWS-owned domain used for AWS service endpoints. In the material found here, it is used for managed AWS MCP Server endpoints that let AI agents access AWS documentation and AWS actions under AWS identity controls.
summary: api.aws currently exposes a documented MCP integration surface here: the AWS Marketplace MCP server on `marketplace-mcp.us-east-1.api.aws/mcp`, which supports OAuth via AWS Sign-In and a SigV4-based IAM path documented for AWS MCP Server clients.
